messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High Datadog ingestion latency detected for org: redwood-prod. some metrics/logs delayed >5m. automated suppression of noisy alerts in progress. see https://status.datadoghq.com/incident/ingestion-2026 for updates
eli (oncall): saw this spike ~2m ago, tracing shows dd-agent -> intake ack times high. dashboards in console are showing large gaps for request_latency, model_tokens, gpu_util.*
Maya Patel: is customer traffic impacted or just observability gaps?
eli (oncall): no service degradation reported yet, traffic looks normal from infra metrics (internal prometheus). but we have blindspots for model-level errors and retry rates. customers on Dedicated might not see traces.
Sagar Rao: copying incident play: if Datadog ingest is delayed, enable fallback telemetry and start synthetic checks. I've queued a temporary log-forward-to-s3 job for last 6m.
Lin Chen: FYI I just opened a Datadog support ticket (ticket 2247) and paged their infra oncall. they acknowledged higher ingest latency in us-east-1.
Support Bot: Datadog ticket 2247 status: acknowledged -> engineers investigating. ETA unknown.
eli (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) mute non-actionable alerts for 30m 2) route critical alerts to PagerDuty via prometheus alertmanager rules 3) enable low-q sampling on verbose parsers 4) persist raw agent payloads to internal S3 bucket for postmortem
Maya Patel: can you post the commands to flip Alertmanager routing? doing it now so we can stop noisy wakeups
eli (oncall): sure. run on infra-admin: ```kubectl -n monitoring exec deploy/alertmanager -- /bin/alertmanager tool reload-config --config-file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager-fallback.yml``` then verify via `curl -s http://alertmanager.monitoring.svc:9093/-/reload`
Sagar Rao: also pushing a temporary rule to force critical_slo_alert to use prometheus remote-write mirror: ```POST /api/v1/rules``` (internal change PR queued, will merge in 2m)
Maya Patel: thanks — I muted the noisy Datadog alerts channel and updated on-call rotation to use prometheus alerts for now :thumbsup:
eli (oncall): can team owning Dedicated customers confirm whether any incoming support tickets referenced missing traces or slow metrics?
Lin Chen: support queue shows 3 customers mentioned missing trace spikes. opened customer-facing note draft: "We're investigating an observability provider outage causing gaps in tracing and dashboards; service performance is not affected. We'll follow up with restored telemetry."
Support Bot: Draft posted to #support-templates for review.
Sagar Rao: quick check: we should also switch fallback for model-serving logs to our collector lambda. command: ```aws lambda invoke --function-name forward-dd-fallback --payload '{"since":"-10m"}' /tmp/out.json```
eli (oncall): doing it. started forwarding from 2405123500 -> s3://redwood-telemetry/dd-fallback/24051235.tar.gz
Maya Patel: can we surface a short customer impact summary for SRE lead and PM? bullet points: - cause: Datadog ingestion latency in us-east-1 (third-party) - impact: temporary blindspots for tracing/logs/metrics; no customer-facing service degradation observed - mitigation: routed critical alerts to prometheus, enabled log fallback to S3, paged Datadog - next steps: monitor DD status, continue forwarding raw payloads, prepare postmortem if gap >1h
eli (oncall): posted summary to #incidents-summary and added to incident doc. linking: https://confluence.redwood.ai/incidents/2405123456
Lin Chen: starting a 15m watch call for handoff at +30m. adding Maya as next oncall to take over.
Maya Patel: I can take the 30->90min window. will own follow-ups and customer comms.
Sagar Rao: note: change of routing means we may see duplicate alerts for a short time. I'll adjust dedupe window to 2m.
eli (oncall): escalation done to Datadog infra, asked for ETA and ingest backlog size. they reported backlog ~12m of events in queue for us-east.
Support Bot: Datadog status page updated: "Ingestion delays impacting some customers in us-east; mitigations in progress." link: https://status.datadoghq.com/incident/ingestion-2026
Maya Patel: since backlog is ~12m, create quick runbook item: - retain forwarded raw payloads until confirm re-ingest - do not rollback any alert routing until Datadog confirms steady state - prepare customer-facing note if data missing >30m
eli (oncall): creating a short checklist in the incident doc and assigning tasks: forward raw -> Sagar, alerting routing -> Maya, customer comms -> Lin, follow up with Datadog -> eli
Lin Chen: adding handoff message for next oncall: "We're in mitigation: Datadog ingestion delay (us-east). Prometheus is primary for alerts. Raw payloads being forwarded to s3. Next: watch DD status for re-ingest confirmation and reconcile metrics after recovery."
Maya Patel: logging final status into thread as I take over. leaving Eli on follow-up with Datadog if they provide ETA. incoming notes: 3 customers affected (support tickets #8421 #8423 #8427).
eli (oncall): copying any post-recovery tasks to postmortem: reconcile missing traces, request re-ingest from Datadog if available, adjust agent backpressure config, review alert thresholds to reduce noise during third-party incidents.
Maya Patel: thanks all. taking over now. will post updates every 15m or on any DD status change. :coffee:
Support Bot: Incident auto-summary: observability ingestion delay (Datadog) -> mitigations applied, on-call handoff to Maya Patel at ts 2405123780."
